frontier: Extensional reflection, deterministic public-trace presentation compilation, and public exact seeded realized effects have all been proved to scalarize or externalize. The remaining semantic gap is whether a fully specified public-N effect can be runtime-effective and non-oracular while its output presentation law is not effectively externally sampleable/enumerable.
next_action: Freeze one exact class of public effective probabilistic/nondeterministic effects and prove a general distributional externalization theorem for it, or construct a fully public executable effect whose support-bearing presentation law provably cannot be externally sampled/enumerated without importing an oracle, secret implementation, hidden factor information, or a reviewed classical factor mechanism.
research_value: This isolates the next semantic boundary after actual-branch opacity was shown insufficient: the externalizability of the public output distribution itself.

successor_gate.new_information_gap: The parent Result crossed deterministic trace compilation but proved that public exact seeded realizations are externally simulable at the distribution level. This separates actual-branch opacity from distributional nonexternalizability and identifies a strictly new semantic boundary.
successor_gate.why_parent_result_does_not_close_it: The theorem assumes public exact seed samplers and public deterministic branch-presentation compilers. It explicitly leaves open public effects whose executable semantics might not admit an effective external sampler/enumerator of explicit presentations.
discriminating_outcomes: a stronger theorem proves every effect in a clearly frozen class of public effective generative semantics is distributionally externalizable, narrowing or potentially exhausting the admissible effect route
a fully public-N, runtime-effective, non-oracular effect is constructed whose support-bearing presentation law is proved not effectively externally sampleable/enumerable
any proposed nonexternalizable effect is shown to require noncomputable oracle access, secret implementation, hidden-factor-correlated environment state, or another inadmissible authority
a survivor is reduced to a reviewed order/smoothness, collision/cycle, square-relation, named-prime p-adic, or direct randomized nonunit mechanism and rejected
successor_gate.kill_condition: Reject ordinary hidden randomness, branch opacity alone, secret code/implementation, noncomputable or physical oracle assumptions presented as public semantics, hidden p/q or factor-correlated environment state, and explicit random presentation/nonunit search.
successor_gate.alternative_route_or_free_exploration_co: Generic opacity and stronger linear typing are already closed. The exact unresolved distinction is distributional externalizability, so broad free exploration would erase a sharp information-flow boundary.
successor_gate.why_new_stage_or_task_is_better_than_sam: The realized-effect task is terminal for public seed-compilable effects. This successor changes the semantic variable from the hidden actual branch to the computability/externalizability of the public output law and can discriminate a genuine new capability from an oracle disguise.
